d: Chestnut brown hair is styled in a voluminous, fluffy bob with choppy bangs and two small hairpins on the left side. Olive green eyes are large and round with a gentle expression, set on a youthful face with the maturity of a young adolescent. The build is slender and small, dressed in a dark forest green short-sleeved dress with a matching belt, paired with a dark blue sash across the chest adorned with various colorful merit badges and a gold medal. Accessories include a dark teal beret with a white emblem, a tan bow tie, white ribbed knee-high socks with brown leather straps, and polished dark brown oxford shoes.
